content:
rachel_pm: Quick sync  propose we build an interop/conformance kit for LangChain + LlamaIndex + gateway tool-calls to streamline marketplace gating. Short goal: 1-page checklist + runnable harness.

tom_infra: agree. infra can host a sandbox and CI job. prefer containerized tests so partners can run locally.

oliver_eng: minimal tests: ingest->index, retrieval accuracy smoke, agent->tool end-to-end, streaming verify, and a fallback route test. each test produces a simple pass/fail + log snippet.

nina_partners: partners will want badges for listing (sandbox-ready, agent-ready, gateway-tested). include clear acceptance criteria.

interop-bot: repo created: `github.com/redwood/interop-kit-agentflow`. README seeded.

evAN_mktg: evan_mktg: marketing will draft badge copy and 15s demo GIFs; can auto-record from CI.

legal_clara: will provide a short consent template for partner listing and a one-line disclaimer. will add to repo under LEGAL/.

tom_infra: CI notes: optional GPU path, default CPU quantized path, rate limits, OAuth invites for partners. we'll seed sandbox with a public 200-doc corpus.

oliver_eng: will add a docker-compose harness and small CLI to run tests; tooling will emit `results.json` (pass/fail plus stdout). will instrument p95 latency and token-cost estimate.

rachel_pm: timeline: prototype Feb 22, partner trials start Mar 6, badge gating Mar 20.

nina_partners: will draft partner README, onboarding email, and acceptance flow.

evAN_mktg: will post badge copy and CI GIF job by Feb 27.

interop-bot: reminder set: design review Feb 28 16:00 UTC.

oliver_eng: opening PR for harness today; tagging reviewers.

rachel_pm: action items captured in repo. keeping this thread as the coordination hub. ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
